title: Kennedy, Three Globalizations of Law and Legal Thought 1850–2000

21.title: The second globalization: the vocabulary of the social
21.text: Kennedy opens the second part with a VOCABULARY that by itself shows what happened: SOCIETY, SOCIOLOGY, SOCIAL ANTHROPOLOGY, SOCIAL SCIENCE, SOCIAL FUNCTION, SOCIAL JUSTICE, SOCIAL REVOLUTION, SOCIALISM; NATIONAL SOCIALISM, SOCIAL DEMOCRACY, SOCIAL CATHOLICISM, SOCIAL CHRISTIANITY, SOCIAL WELFARE, SOCIAL PURPOSE, SOCIAL NEED, THE SOCIAL QUESTION; SOCIAL PROBLEM, SOCIAL POLICY, SOCIAL LAW, SOCIAL RIGHTS, SOCIAL LEGISLATION, SOCIAL INSURANCE, SOCIAL WORK. The second globalization began around 1900 and HAD EXHAUSTED ITS FORCE BY THE END OF THE SECOND WORLD WAR, but it strongly influenced thinking about international questions and about Third World development strategies AS LATE AS THE 1960s. THIS TIME WHAT WAS GLOBALIZED WAS A CRITIQUE OF THE FIRST GLOBALIZATION AND A PROJECT OF RECONSTRUCTION. The critique was that the European mainstream of the late 19th century had ABUSED DEDUCTION IN LEGAL METHOD AND WAS 'INDIVIDUALIST' IN LEGAL SUBSTANCE. The slogan of the second globalization was 'THE SOCIAL' — an abstraction WHICH IN THIS PERIOD PLAYED ROUGHLY THE ROLE PLAYED BY RIGHT, WILL AND FAULT IN CLT. The first innovators were German speakers — JHERING, GIERKE, EHRLICH — but the main globalizers were the FRENCH: SALEILLES, GENY, DUGUIT, LAMBERT, JOSSERAND, GOUNOD and GURVITCH.

cards.q: What was globalized in the second globalization, and how did the critique run?
cards.a: A CRITIQUE OF THE FIRST GLOBALIZATION AND A PROJECT OF RECONSTRUCTION. The critique: the European mainstream of the late 19th century ABUSED DEDUCTION in legal method and was 'INDIVIDUALIST' in legal substance. The slogan was 'THE SOCIAL' — an abstraction playing the role that RIGHT, WILL AND FAULT played in CLT.

cards.q: Who invented the social and who globalized it?
cards.a: THE FIRST INNOVATORS were German speakers — JHERING, GIERKE, EHRLICH. THE MAIN GLOBALIZERS were the FRENCH: Saleilles, Geny, Duguit, Lambert, Josserand, Gounod and Gurvitch.

22.title: Interdependence and saving liberalism from itself
22.text: With the MARXISTS — the other significant school of the early 20th century critical of CLT — the social people had in common that they INTERPRETED THE ACTUAL REGIME OF THE WILL THEORY AS AN EPIPHENOMENON IN RELATION TO SOME 'BASE': for the Marxists that base was THE CAPITALIST ECONOMY, for the social people 'SOCIETY CONCEIVED AS AN ORGANISM'. Both groups hold that the will theory in some sense 'FITTED' the socio-economic conditions of the first half of the 19th century. BUT THE SOCIAL PEOPLE WERE ANTI-MARXIST JUST AS THEY WERE ANTI-LAISSEZ-FAIRE. THEIR AIM WAS TO SAVE LIBERALISM FROM ITSELF. Their basic idea: the conditions of life of the late 19th century constitute a SOCIAL TRANSFORMATION consisting of URBANISATION, INDUSTRIALISATION, ORGANISATIONAL SOCIETY AND THE GLOBALIZATION OF MARKETS — all summed up in the idea of 'INTERDEPENDENCE'. BECAUSE THE WILL THEORY WAS INDIVIDUALIST, IT IGNORED INTERDEPENDENCE AND ENDORSED PARTICULAR LEGAL RULES THAT PERMITTED MANY KINDS OF ANTI-SOCIAL BEHAVIOUR. The crisis of the modern factory (industrial accidents, pauperisation) and of the urban slum, and later the crisis of the financial markets and the Great Depression — all of it followed FROM THE INABILITY OF A COHERENTLY INDIVIDUALIST LAW TO RESPOND TO THE COHERENTLY SOCIAL NEEDS OF MODERN CONDITIONS OF INTERDEPENDENCE. AFTER 1919 they extended this analysis TO THE PROBLEM OF WAR, understood as the product of the failure of an international order founded on THE LOGIC OF SOVEREIGNTY, HIGHLY ANALOGOUS TO THE PROBLEMS OF MARKETS FOUNDED ON THE LOGIC OF PROPERTY.

terms.def: The idea summing up urbanisation, industrialisation, organisational society and the globalization of markets — what the will theory ignored.

cards.q: What did the social people share with the Marxists and where did they differ?
cards.a: In common: they interpreted the regime of the will theory as an EPIPHENOMENON of a 'base' — for the Marxists the capitalist economy, for the social people SOCIETY CONCEIVED AS AN ORGANISM. They differed fundamentally: THE SOCIAL PEOPLE WERE ANTI-MARXIST JUST AS THEY WERE ANTI-LAISSEZ-FAIRE. THEIR AIM WAS TO SAVE LIBERALISM FROM ITSELF.

cards.q: How did the social people connect industrial accidents, slums, the Great Depression and war?
cards.a: All of it followed FROM THE INABILITY OF A COHERENTLY INDIVIDUALIST LAW TO RESPOND TO THE COHERENTLY SOCIAL NEEDS OF MODERN CONDITIONS OF INTERDEPENDENCE. AFTER 1919 they extended the analysis TO WAR: the product of the failure of an international order founded on THE LOGIC OF SOVEREIGNTY, ANALOGOUS to the problems of markets founded on THE LOGIC OF PROPERTY.

23.title: Is-to-ought and its legitimating breadth
23.text: From that analysis of the 'is' they derived the 'ought' of a reform programme — and it was astonishingly successful: LABOUR LEGISLATION, THE REGULATION OF URBAN AREAS through tenancy, sanitary and zoning regimes, THE REGULATION OF FINANCIAL MARKETS and THE DEVELOPMENT OF NEW INSTITUTIONS OF INTERNATIONAL LAW. And the key observation: THE 'IS-TO-OUGHT' MOVE APPEALED TO A VERY WIDE RANGE OF LEGITIMATING RHETORICS. They ran across the whole left-right spectrum and LEFT OUT ONLY MARXIST COLLECTIVISM AT ONE END AND PURE MANCHESTERISM AT THE OTHER. The social could thus be founded on SOCIALIST OR SOCIAL DEMOCRATIC ideology (Durkheimian, say), on the SOCIAL CHRISTIANITY of the Protestant sects, on NEO-KANTIAN 'SITUATIONAL NATURAL LAW', on COMTEAN POSITIVISM, on CATHOLIC NATURAL LAW, on BISMARCKIAN/DISRAELIAN SOCIAL CONSERVATISM OR ON FASCIST IDEOLOGY. In other words THE SOCIAL WAS, LIKE CLT, AT FIRST A CONSCIOUSNESS — though always in a conflictual relation to CLT, not straightforwardly hegemonic as CLT had been in the brief period roughly between 1850 and 1890 — within which various and contradictory ideological projects could be developed. Whatever it was, the slogans included ORGANICISM, PURPOSE, FUNCTION, REPRODUCTION, WELFARE, INSTRUMENTALISM (LAW IS A MEANS TO AN END) — AND THEREFORE ANTI-DEDUCTION, BECAUSE A LEGAL RULE IS MERELY A MEANS OF ACHIEVING SOCIAL PURPOSES.

cards.q: On which ideologies could the social be founded, and what did it leave out?
cards.a: On socialist or social democratic (Durkheimian), social Christianity, NEO-KANTIAN 'SITUATIONAL NATURAL LAW', Comtean positivism, Catholic natural law, BISMARCKIAN/DISRAELIAN SOCIAL CONSERVATISM or FASCIST IDEOLOGY. It left out ONLY MARXIST COLLECTIVISM AT ONE END AND PURE MANCHESTERISM AT THE OTHER.

cards.q: What were the slogans of the social, and why does anti-deduction follow from them?
cards.a: ORGANICISM, PURPOSE, FUNCTION, REPRODUCTION, WELFARE, INSTRUMENTALISM (LAW IS A MEANS TO AN END) — and therefore ANTI-DEDUCTION, BECAUSE A LEGAL RULE IS MERELY A MEANS OF ACHIEVING SOCIAL PURPOSES, not a member of a coherent system.

24.title: The abuse of deduction: what exactly was charged against CLT
24.text: An essential part of the social critique of classical legal thought was the claim that CLT MAINTAINED AN APPEARANCE OF OBJECTIVITY IN LEGAL INTERPRETATION ONLY THROUGH AN ABUSE OF DEDUCTION. On the social people's account, the people of CLT understood themselves as interpreters (judges, administrative officials, professors of law) operating by A SYSTEM OF INDUCTION AND DEDUCTION PREMISED ON THE COHERENCE, THAT IS THE INTERNAL LOGICAL CONSISTENCY, OF THE SYSTEM OF ENACTED LEGAL NORMS. THREE MODES: (1) find an applicable enacted rule; (2) DEVELOP A GAP-FILLING RULE BY A CHAIN OF DEDUCTIONS FROM A MORE ABSTRACT ENACTED RULE OR PRINCIPLE; (3) THE METHOD OF 'CONSTRUCTIONS' — DETERMINE WHAT UNENACTED PRINCIPLE MUST BE PART OF THE 'SYSTEM' GIVEN ITS VARIOUS ENACTED ELEMENTS IF IT IS TO BE REGARDED AS INTERNALLY COHERENT, AND THEN DERIVE THE GAP-FILLING RULE FROM THAT CONSTRUCTION. And now the trap: on the social analysis, INTERPRETERS WITHIN CLT ALWAYS HAD TO UNDERSTAND THEMSELVES AS LOGICALLY COMPELLED IN ONE OF THOSE WAYS, AND COULD THEREFORE NEVER LEGITIMATELY AND CONSCIOUSLY WORK AT ADAPTING THE LAW TO THE NEW CONDITIONS OF THE LATE 19TH CENTURY. Those conditions meanwhile constantly presented them, as interpreters, with GAPS. WHAT THE PEOPLE OF CLT HAD TO DO IN ORDER TO REMAIN TRUE TO THEIR ROLE AS THEY UNDERSTOOD IT WAS TO 'ABUSE DEDUCTION': THEY HAD TO MAKE DECISIONS TAKEN FOR OTHER REASONS LOOK LIKE THE RESULT OF DEDUCTIVE WORK PREMISED ON THE COHERENCE OF THE SYSTEM.

terms.def: Making decisions taken for other reasons look like the result of deduction premised on the coherence of the system.

cards.q: What three modes of CLT legal reasoning does the social critique describe?
cards.a: 1) Find an APPLICABLE ENACTED RULE. 2) DEVELOP A GAP-FILLING RULE BY A CHAIN OF DEDUCTIONS from a more abstract rule or principle. 3) THE METHOD OF 'CONSTRUCTIONS' — determine what UNENACTED PRINCIPLE must be part of the system if it is to be internally coherent, and derive the gap-filling rule from it.

cards.q: Why, on the social account, did the people of CLT have to 'abuse deduction'?
cards.a: Because they had to understand themselves as LOGICALLY COMPELLED and could not legitimately and consciously adapt the law to new conditions — while those conditions constantly presented them with GAPS. To remain true to their role THEY HAD TO MAKE DECISIONS TAKEN FOR OTHER REASONS LOOK LIKE THE RESULT OF DEDUCTIVE WORK.

25.title: Four positive proposals of the social
25.text: Besides the critique, the social offered FOUR POSITIVE PROPOSALS: (1) THE MOVE FROM A SOCIAL 'IS' TO AN ADAPTIVE 'OUGHT' FOR LAW; (2) THE MOVE FROM A DEDUCTIVE TO AN INSTRUMENTAL APPROACH TO THE FORMULATION OF NORMS; (3) THE ACKNOWLEDGEMENT, NOT ONLY BY THE LEGISLATOR BUT BY LEGAL SCIENTISTS, JUDGES AND ADMINISTRATIVE AGENCIES, OF THE OPEN EXISTENCE OF GAPS IN THE FORMALLY VALID ORDER; (4) AN ANCHORING IN THE NORMATIVE PRACTICES — THE 'LIVING LAW' — CONTINUOUSLY DEVELOPED BY GROUPS BETWEEN THE STATE AND THE INDIVIDUAL. Kennedy notes that anti-formalists existed outside the social too: DEMOGUE, HECK, HOLMES, HOHFELD, LLEWELLYN. PLURALISM: groups — merchant communities, trade unions — develop new norms according to 'social needs'; these are 'VALID' 'LIVING LAW', NOT DEDUCTIONS FROM INDIVIDUALIST POSTULATES, and should be the basis of state law. The pluralist position is therefore A COMPLEX MIXTURE OF 'IS' AND 'OUGHT'. The Mafia code of OMERTA and canon law are as interesting within it as any other non-state order. IN THE NORMATIVE ROLE, however, the social people were chiefly interested in the MEDIEVAL CORPORATIONS, THE LAW MERCHANT, THE LAW OF THE INDUSTRIAL PLANT AND CUSTOMARY INTERNATIONAL LAW — and Kennedy's hypothesis as to why: BECAUSE IN EACH OF THEM IT COULD BE ARGUED THAT NON-STATE LAW IS 'MORE SOCIAL' THAN STATE LAW.

terms.def: The normative practices continuously developed by groups between the state and the individual; on the pluralist view they should be the basis of state law.

cards.q: What four positive proposals did the social offer?
cards.a: 1) From a social 'IS' to an ADAPTIVE 'OUGHT'. 2) From a DEDUCTIVE to an INSTRUMENTAL approach to the formulation of norms. 3) The acknowledgement, not only by the legislator but by scientists, JUDGES AND ADMINISTRATIVE AGENCIES, of the open existence of GAPS. 4) An anchoring in the 'LIVING LAW' — the normative practices of groups between the state and the individual.

cards.q: Why were the social people chiefly interested in the medieval corporations, the law merchant and customary international law?
cards.a: Kennedy's hypothesis: BECAUSE IN EACH OF THEM IT COULD BE ARGUED THAT NON-STATE LAW IS 'MORE SOCIAL' THAN STATE LAW. Mafia omertà or canon law are theoretically just as interesting, they simply did not fit the normative role.

26.title: Institutionalism and corporatism
26.text: To understand non-state orders it was necessary (a) to identify the SOCIAL PRACTICES distinguishing non-state law from mere custom and mores and (b) to explain the COHERENCE of non-state law. The concept of the INSTITUTION solves both: AN ORGANISATION, A SET OF ROLES, ENDURING IN TIME BUT WITH CHANGING PERSONNEL, ORIENTED AT ITS FOUNDING MOMENT TOWARDS (ALTERABLE) PURPOSES TRANSCENDING THE INDIVIDUAL INTERESTS OF THE ROLE-HOLDERS. Even a purely profit-making corporation is an institution, because it has a business plan. AND THE CONSEQUENCE WORTH REMEMBERING: ON THIS VIEW THE STATE BECOMES ONE INSTITUTION AMONG MANY. Norms derive their rational coherence and their 'validity' from a combination of THE INSTITUTION'S COMMITMENT TO ITS PURPOSE AND ITS HISTORY OF DEVELOPMENT; in the 'ought' mode, INSTITUTIONS SHOULD DEVELOP NORMS SO AS TO FURTHER THEIR PURPOSES, AND THE STATE SHOULD RECOGNISE AND FACILITATE THAT PROCESS RATHER THAN IGNORE OR SUPPRESS IT. (The French institutionalists HAURIOU, RENARD, DELOS; the Italian SANTI ROMANO.) CORPORATISM goes a step further: THE PLURAL INSTITUTIONS ALL CONTRIBUTE TO THE SELF-MAINTENANCE AND EVOLUTION OF SOCIETY AS A WHOLE AND TOGETHER ARE A BETTER 'REPRESENTATIVE' OF SOCIETY THAN AN ELECTORAL PROCESS BASED ON THE VOTES OF INDIVIDUALS. A legislative process built on individual voting will not rationally supervise the self-regulation of institutions; it is better TO GIVE THE INSTITUTIONS DIRECT ACCESS TO STATE POWER. And note this sentence: THE FASCIST REGIMES OF THE 1930s ADOPTED CORPORATISM ALONG WITH PRESIDENTIALISM AS AN ALTERNATIVE TO PARLIAMENTARY DEMOCRACY AND DISCREDITED IT SO THOROUGHLY THAT IT IS HARD TO REMEMBER THAT, IN THE FORM OF INDUSTRIAL BOARDS OF LABOUR AND MANAGEMENT WITH POWER TO ISSUE BINDING REGULATIONS, IT WAS A CENTRAL ELEMENT OF ROOSEVELT'S FIRST NEW DEAL.

terms.def: An organisation, a set of roles, enduring in time with changing personnel, oriented towards purposes transcending the individual interests of the role-holders.

cards.q: How did the social define an 'institution', and what follows from it for the state?
cards.a: AN ORGANISATION, A SET OF ROLES, ENDURING IN TIME BUT WITH CHANGING PERSONNEL, oriented towards (alterable) PURPOSES TRANSCENDING THE INDIVIDUAL INTERESTS of the role-holders. Even a profit-making corporation is an institution, because it has a business plan. THE CONSEQUENCE: THE STATE BECOMES ONE INSTITUTION AMONG MANY.

cards.q: What does corporatism claim, and how did it end?
cards.a: That THE PLURAL INSTITUTIONS TOGETHER ARE A BETTER 'REPRESENTATIVE' OF SOCIETY THAN AN ELECTORAL PROCESS based on individual votes, and should therefore be given DIRECT ACCESS TO STATE POWER. THE FASCIST REGIMES OF THE 1930s adopted it as an alternative to parliamentary democracy and DISCREDITED IT SO THOROUGHLY that it is forgotten that, as INDUSTRIAL BOARDS, it was central to ROOSEVELT'S FIRST NEW DEAL.

27.title: Groups between the individual and the people: a harmonic, not a conflict ideology
27.text: The social is a transformation of the CLT model in which individuals make up A PEOPLE, with rights secured by a state that is sovereign in a decentralised association with other sovereign states. In the social there is an intense focus not only on the plurality of institutions below and above the level of the state but also on GROUPS BETWEEN THE LEVEL OF THE INDIVIDUAL AND THAT OF THE PEOPLE — the most important being SOCIAL CLASSES (especially labour and capital) and NATIONAL MINORITIES. And here is the contrast that matters most in the whole chapter: WHEREAS MARXISM WAS A 'CONFLICT IDEOLOGY' PROPHESYING THE VICTORY OF THE WORKING CLASS IN A MORTAL STRUGGLE WITH THE CAPITALIST CLASS, THE SOCIAL WAS A 'HARMONIC IDEOLOGY' PROCLAIMING A FUNCTION FOR EVERY ORGANISED INTEREST AND THE EXISTENCE OF A 'PUBLIC INTEREST' IN COORDINATING THEIR INTERDEPENDENT ACTIVITIES SO AS TO MAXIMISE SOCIAL WELFARE. The social people were against CLT's tendency TO DENY THE JURISTIC REALITY OF ANYTHING OTHER THAN THE INDIVIDUAL OR THE STATE. There were pluralities in CLT too, but: (1) A PLURALITY OF RIGHT-HOLDERS; (2) A PLURALITY OF VOLKSGEISTER, A PLURALITY OF FAMILY LAW REGIMES ACCORDING TO NATIONAL CULTURES, A PLURALITY OF PUBLIC LAW ARRANGEMENTS. THOSE PLURALITIES WERE, HOWEVER, PERIPHERAL TO THE LEGAL CORE, WHICH WAS THE PRIVATE LAW OF OBLIGATIONS, WITH CONTRACT LAW — THE LAW OF FREE WILL PROCEEDING FROM PROPERTY RIGHTS — AS THE CORE OF THE CORE.

cards.q: Why was the social a 'harmonic' rather than a 'conflict' ideology?
cards.a: Because unlike MARXISM, which prophesied THE VICTORY OF THE WORKING CLASS IN A MORTAL STRUGGLE, it proclaimed A FUNCTION FOR EVERY ORGANISED INTEREST and the existence of a 'PUBLIC INTEREST' IN COORDINATING THEIR INTERDEPENDENT ACTIVITIES so as to maximise social welfare.

cards.q: Were there pluralities in CLT too, and how did they differ from the social's?
cards.a: Yes: A PLURALITY OF RIGHT-HOLDERS, OF VOLKSGEISTER, OF FAMILY LAW REGIMES and OF PUBLIC LAW ARRANGEMENTS. BUT ALL OF THEM WERE PERIPHERAL TO THE LEGAL CORE, which was the private law of obligations with CONTRACT LAW as the core of the core. The social by contrast targets GROUPS BETWEEN THE INDIVIDUAL AND THE PEOPLE — classes and national minorities.

28.title: Labour law and industrial peace
28.text: The concrete legal innovations of the social in labour law: SOCIAL INSURANCE AGAINST INDUSTRIAL ACCIDENTS AS A COMPULSORY PART OF THE WAGE CONTRACT, TRADE UNION ORGANISATION AS AN INVOLUNTARY ASSOCIATION, COMPULSORY COLLECTIVE BARGAINING — all in a context of PERVASIVE REGULATION FROM ABOVE. The justification: 'INDUSTRIAL WAR' (STRIFE, CLASS WAR) THREATENS THE WHOLE OF SOCIETY WITH CATASTROPHIC INTERRUPTIONS OF PRODUCTION. THE PUBLIC INTEREST LAY IN 'INDUSTRIAL PEACE' AND JUSTIFIED DISCARDING INDIVIDUALIST AND FORMALIST CONCEPTS — to the point where A COLLECTIVELY BARGAINED UNION CONTRACT DETERMINES THE TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT OF A WORKER WHO IS NOT A UNION MEMBER. That is a textbook example of how social thought changes the very structure of legal obligation: the obligation no longer proceeds from the will of the person bound.

cards.q: What new legal forms did social labour law introduce?
cards.a: SOCIAL INSURANCE AGAINST ACCIDENTS AS A COMPULSORY PART OF THE WAGE CONTRACT, TRADE UNION ORGANISATION AS AN INVOLUNTARY ASSOCIATION, COMPULSORY COLLECTIVE BARGAINING — all within pervasive regulation from above.

cards.q: How did 'industrial peace' justify discarding individualist concepts?
cards.a: 'INDUSTRIAL WAR' threatens the whole of society with CATASTROPHIC INTERRUPTIONS OF PRODUCTION, so the public interest lies in INDUSTRIAL PEACE. To the point where A COLLECTIVELY BARGAINED UNION CONTRACT DETERMINES THE TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT OF A NON-MEMBER — the obligation no longer proceeds from the will of the person bound.

29.title: Social legislation, expertise and the inversion of core and periphery
29.text: Social legislation meant AN EXPANSION OF THE REGULATORY FUNCTIONS OF THE STATE and THE CARVING OUT AND REDEFINITION AS PUBLIC LAW OF EXTENSIVE AREAS THAT HAD PREVIOUSLY FALLEN SAFELY WITHIN THE DOMAIN OF RIGHT, WILL AND FAULT. Social law coordinated the individual willing subjects of CLT in the public interest through PUBLIC AGENCIES charged with giving concrete content to ABSTRACT AND VAGUE STATUTORY DECLARATIONS — the prohibition of 'CONTRACTS IN RESTRAINT OF TRADE', of 'UNFAIR COMPETITION', of 'UNFAIR LABOUR PRACTICES', of 'DECEPTIVE PRACTICES'. The agencies were to bring EXPERTISE — social science and concrete pragmatic knowledge alike — and operated through INSPECTORATES applying LOW-LEVEL CRIMINAL SANCTIONS OR INJUNCTIONS, in procedures MUCH LESS FORMAL than those emblematic of CLT. In place of the law of obligations the salient fields are ADMINISTRATIVE LAW (for all social legislation), then LABOUR LAW, FAMILY LAW AND INTERNATIONAL LAW. And the result must be sayable in one sentence: BY THE 1930s THE SOCIAL PEOPLE HAD INVERTED THE STRUCTURE OF CLT AND THE PERIPHERY HAD BECOME THE CORE. After a brief flirtation with the judge (in France and Germany at the beginning of the 20th century), the heroes of the social current became THE LEGISLATOR, writing a multitude of special statutes, together with THE ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICIAL, who issued and enforced detailed regulations. The literature of the social was the work of a new breed of law professor — NOT THE MAGISTERIAL AUTHOR OF CODES BUT THE LAW REFORMER: he writes theory, conducts studies, drafts statutes and in the doctrinal literature supervises their implementation and eventual amendment in the light of experience.

cards.q: How did the social change the order of the fields of law?
cards.a: In place of the law of obligations the salient fields are ADMINISTRATIVE LAW (for all social legislation), then LABOUR, FAMILY AND INTERNATIONAL LAW. BY THE 1930s THE SOCIAL PEOPLE HAD INVERTED THE STRUCTURE OF CLT AND THE PERIPHERY HAD BECOME THE CORE.

cards.q: Who was the hero of the social, and how did its professor differ from CLT's?
cards.a: THE LEGISLATOR writing a multitude of special statutes, together with THE ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICIAL issuing and enforcing detailed regulations (the judge was only a brief flirtation). The professor of the social was NOT THE MAGISTERIAL AUTHOR OF A CODE BUT A LAW REFORMER: he writes theory, conducts studies, drafts statutes and supervises their implementation.

30.title: The social was social-scientific — and the 'study' as an instrument
30.text: The professors of the social were not politically pigeonholed and were not open to the charge of rejecting scientific objectivity, BECAUSE THE SOCIAL WAS SOCIAL-SCIENTIFIC. THE LEGAL SCIENCE OF CLT WAS A SCIENCE OF LEGAL CATEGORIES, A SCIENCE OF LEGAL TECHNIQUE; THE SOCIAL WAS ALLIED WITH SOCIOLOGY, ECONOMICS AND PSYCHOLOGY. A key element of the is-to-ought move was the 'STUDY', beginning with industrial accidents at the turn of the century. The premise of the study is worth remembering, because it explains the whole political economy of reform: THERE IS A POLITICALLY POWERFUL, CENTRIST MIDDLE-CLASS AUDIENCE INCLINED TO ASSUME THAT THINGS ARE GENERALLY GOING WELL; WHEN A STUDY ALERTS IT TO A DANGER TO ITSELF (UNSANITARY FOOD PROCESSING) OR TO A SUFFICIENTLY BLATANT ABUSE OF OTHERS (CONDITIONS IN THE MINES), IT WILL SUPPORT A REGULATORY REGIME IN THE 'PUBLIC INTEREST', NOT FOR PARTISAN POLITICAL REASONS. The social science of the time was a mixture of EVOLUTIONISM, PRAGMATISM IN THE DEWEYAN TRADITION AND VARIOUS FORMS OF POSITIVISM (statistical empirical investigation). When the social jurist stood up against the classical legal positivist as a formalist dinosaur, he did so IN THE NAME OF HIS DISCIPLINE, NOT OF SUBJECTIVISM. And here is the point to remember as a whole transformation in a single sentence: BY THE COMBINATION OF PLURALISM, INSTITUTIONALISM AND A COMMITMENT TO EMPIRICAL INQUIRY, THE 'OTHER' OF LAW CEASED TO BE MORALITY, AS IT HAD BEEN IN CLT, AND BECAME 'SOCIETY'.

cards.q: On what premise did the 'study' rest as an instrument of social reform?
cards.a: That there is A POLITICALLY POWERFUL CENTRIST MIDDLE-CLASS AUDIENCE that assumes things are going well; when a study alerts it to A DANGER TO ITSELF (unsanitary food) or to A BLATANT ABUSE OF OTHERS (the mines), IT WILL SUPPORT A REGULATORY REGIME IN THE 'PUBLIC INTEREST', NOT FOR PARTISAN REASONS.

cards.q: What was the 'other' of law in CLT and what in the social?
cards.a: In CLT the 'other' of law was MORALITY. By the combination of PLURALISM, INSTITUTIONALISM AND A COMMITMENT TO EMPIRICAL INQUIRY it became, in the social, 'SOCIETY'. (The legal science of CLT was a science of legal categories, of TECHNIQUE; the social was allied with SOCIOLOGY, ECONOMICS AND PSYCHOLOGY.)

31.title: Rebuilding the whole juristic universe
31.text: One juristic response to social legislation was TO ASSIMILATE IT TO THE CLASSICAL POSITIVIST MODEL BY ADDING NEW LEGAL SUBJECTS WITHOUT CHANGING THE PREMISES OR METHODS OF DOCTRINAL ANALYSIS. (In every country with Western legal education, part and sometimes a very large part of teaching proceeds this way: the classical fields coherent classically, the social fields coherent socially.) The social jurists were more ambitious: REFORM REQUIRES A THOROUGH REBUILDING OF THE JURISTIC UNIVERSE. CIVIL PROCEDURE: the adversary system is obviously ill adapted to a modern interdependent system — new types of proceeding are needed outside the individualist battle model. CRIMINAL LAW: TO INDIVIDUALISE PUNISHMENT AND MAKE IT SOCIALLY EFFECTIVE BY IDENTIFYING TYPES OF CRIMINAL AND THE SOCIAL CAUSES OF CRIME. EVEN CONTRACT LAW, the core of the core, needed revision — PRE-CONTRACTUAL DUTIES, A LIBERALISATION OF EXCUSES, A FUNCTIONAL RATHER THAN FORMALIST INTERPRETATION OF FORMALITIES. NEW TYPES OF COURT: LABOUR, COMMERCIAL, JUVENILE AND FAMILY. Commercial law was to adapt to the new style of business — TRANSACTIONS BETWEEN VERY LARGE FIRMS OR BETWEEN LARGE ENTERPRISES AND INDIVIDUALS WITH NO BARGAINING POWER WHATEVER. Corporate law was to be rebuilt on the concept of the RADICAL SEPARATION OF OWNERSHIP AND CONTROL (BERLE AND MEANS, 1932).

cards.q: What two juristic responses to social legislation were there?
cards.a: 1) To ASSIMILATE it to the classical positivist model by ADDING NEW SUBJECTS WITHOUT CHANGING THE PREMISES — much teaching still proceeds this way (classical fields classically, social fields socially). 2) The more ambitious social position: REFORM REQUIRES A THOROUGH REBUILDING OF THE WHOLE JURISTIC UNIVERSE.

cards.q: How did the social want to rebuild criminal, contract and corporate law?
cards.a: CRIMINAL: individualise punishment and make it SOCIALLY EFFECTIVE by identifying TYPES OF CRIMINAL AND THE SOCIAL CAUSES OF CRIME. CONTRACT: pre-contractual duties, A LIBERALISATION OF EXCUSES, FUNCTIONAL rather than formalist interpretation of formalities. CORPORATE: rebuild on the concept of the RADICAL SEPARATION OF OWNERSHIP AND CONTROL (Berle and Means, 1932).

32.title: Sources of law, gaps and interdisciplinarity
32.text: The anti-formalist strand stressed the GAPS, CONFLICTS AND AMBIGUITIES in the corpus of positive law and thereby the role of the judge EITHER AS AN ABUSER OF DEDUCTION OR AS A RATIONAL LEGISLATOR. In the USA, STARE DECISIS WAS DISCREDITED AS THE ABUSE OF DEDUCTION PAR EXCELLENCE. The civilian dispute over what is a 'source of law' was resolved IN FAVOUR OF THE LEGITIMACY OF JURISPRUDENCE, THAT IS OF JUDGE-MADE LAW. And further — the step that gives the whole thing its reach: ALL INTERPRETERS OF LAW, PROFESSORS, ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICIALS AND LAWYERS DRAFTING CONTRACTS, CHOOSING LITIGATION STRATEGY AND ADVISING ON LIABILITY, PARTICIPATE IN THE MAKING OF LAW. Kennedy adds a practical warning: THE SOCIAL COULD BE STRANGLED BY JUDICIAL HOSTILITY — labour or family courts required judges who detested the whole idea of the new juristic institutions. ONLY WHERE JUDGES, OFFICIALS AND LAWYERS UNDERSTAND NOT ONLY THE RATIO BUT ALSO THE TECHNIQUE OF REFORM DOES REFORM WORK. From this followed a new view of the curriculum: whoever teaches the new labour law course should know sociology, economics and psychology; it would be useful to have a few 'TAME' ECONOMISTS, SOCIOLOGISTS AND PSYCHOLOGISTS on the faculty. And Kennedy's characterisation, worth recalling: FOR THE SOCIAL, INTERDISCIPLINARITY MEANT THE LAW PROFESSOR AS A GENERALIST WHOSE ABILITIES ALLOW HIM TO MASTER ALL THE OTHER DISCIPLINES WITHOUT FORMAL TRAINING.

cards.q: How did the social resolve the question of the sources of law?
cards.a: In favour of THE LEGITIMACY OF JURISPRUDENCE, that is of JUDGE-MADE LAW — and it went further: ALL INTERPRETERS OF LAW (professors, administrative officials, lawyers drafting contracts, choosing litigation strategy and advising on liability) PARTICIPATE IN THE MAKING OF LAW. In the USA STARE DECISIS was discredited as THE ABUSE OF DEDUCTION PAR EXCELLENCE.

cards.q: What did interdisciplinarity mean for the social?
cards.a: THE LAW PROFESSOR AS A GENERALIST WHOSE ABILITIES ALLOW HIM TO MASTER ALL THE OTHER DISCIPLINES WITHOUT FORMAL TRAINING. The practical reason: only where judges, officials and lawyers understand not merely the RATIO but the TECHNIQUE of reform does reform work.

33.title: The social claimed it was not about politics — and the liberals did not believe it
33.text: The social jurists claimed that A MERE COMMITMENT TO SOCIAL JUSTICE IN THE IS-TO-OUGHT MODE DID NOT EXPOSE THEM TO THE DANGER OF ERODING THE DISTINCTION BETWEEN LAW AND POLITICS. They generally conceded the INTERNAL COHERENCE OF INDIVIDUALIST DEDUCTIVE LAW (stressing GAPS, not irremediable contradictions) and claimed THE SAME COHERENCE FOR SOCIAL LAW. THE SECOND CLAIM WAS STRONGLY CONTESTED: LIBERALS STUCK ON THE APPARATUS AND ASPIRATIONS OF CLT UNDERSTOOD THE SOCIAL AS CHAOTIC, WITHOUT A SINGLE COUNTER-PRINCIPLE TO SET AGAINST RIGHT AND WILL; AND THEY SAW THE VARIETY OF THE SOCIAL'S POLICIES AS A SYMPTOM OF THE TRAGIC POLITICISATION OF LAW FOLLOWING A PREMATURE ABANDONMENT OF LEGAL SCIENCE IN FAVOUR OF SOCIAL SCIENCE, NOT AS EVIDENCE OF THE SOCIAL'S SUPRA-POLITICAL TRUTH.

cards.q: How did the social defend the distinction between law and politics, and what did the liberals charge?
cards.a: It claimed that a commitment to social justice in the is-to-ought mode does not erode that distinction, and claimed THE SAME COHERENCE for social law as it conceded to individualist law. The liberals, however, understood the social as CHAOTIC, WITHOUT A SINGLE COUNTER-PRINCIPLE — and saw the variety of its policies as A SYMPTOM OF THE TRAGIC POLITICISATION OF LAW after a premature abandonment of legal science.

34.title: How the social spread: old channels, new contents
34.text: The second globalization followed the channels of the first. Students from all over Europe went to study law in FRANCE AND GERMANY; from the mid-19th century to the 1930s students from the rest of the world under Western influence poured into Europe; from the colonies to their 'metropoles' (Senegalese to Paris, Indonesians to Amsterdam). Where they had a choice, they went TO THE EUROPEAN METROPOLE WITH THE GREATEST PRESTIGE IN THEIR PART OF THE PERIPHERY — Latin Americans to Paris, Americans to Germany. FIRST GERMANY, LATER FRANCE were the sources of the social, but it developed in parallel in many places, AND ITS POLITICAL COLOUR VARIED FROM PLACE TO PLACE: IN ITALY it was at first MODERATELY LEFT, THEN FASCIST. IN SPAIN (FRANCO), PORTUGAL (SALAZAR) AND GREECE (METAXAS) IT WAS FASCIST; IN THE NETHERLANDS AND (FABIAN) BRITAIN MODERATELY LEFT. The American sociological jurists — POUND, CARDOZO, BRANDEIS — produced a version first moderately left and then moderately right; they drew on the French and the Germans, but were strongly influenced by HOLMES, WHO DEVELOPED A DISTINCTIVELY AMERICAN VARIANT OF THE 'ABUSE OF DEDUCTION' THESIS BEFORE GENY.

cards.q: What political colour did the social have in individual countries?
cards.a: In ITALY at first MODERATELY LEFT, then FASCIST. In SPAIN (Franco), PORTUGAL (Salazar) and GREECE (Metaxas) FASCIST. In the NETHERLANDS and Fabian BRITAIN MODERATELY LEFT. In the USA (Pound, Cardozo, Brandeis) first moderately left and then moderately right.

cards.q: What role did Holmes play in the American version of the social?
cards.a: HE DEVELOPED A DISTINCTIVELY AMERICAN VARIANT OF THE 'ABUSE OF DEDUCTION' THESIS BEFORE GENY and strongly influenced Pound, Cardozo and Brandeis, who otherwise drew on the French and the Germans.

35.title: Nationalism in three modes
35.text: As the social settled in the West, students from eastern Europe, Latin America, southern, eastern and south-eastern Asia, the Arab world and Africa appropriated it and took it home. NATIONALISM WAS A KEY DIMENSION OF THE DIFFUSION, BUT IN AT LEAST THREE MODES, NOT AS A SINGLE PHENOMENON. (1) NATIONALISM AS IRREDENTISM AND A DRIVING FORCE OF ETHNIC PURITY — which the progressive European social people regarded, along with class conflict, as a scourge capable of destroying European civilisation. The theorists of the social therefore undertook A PROFOUND RETHINKING OF PUBLIC INTERNATIONAL LAW in an attempt to contain and shape nationalism as A LIFE-GIVING AND LIFE-DESTROYING IRRATIONAL FORCE. The result: THE MANDATE SYSTEM, THE SHIFT TO INSTITUTIONS (THE LEAGUE OF NATIONS), BRICOLAGE INSTITUTIONS SUCH AS THE FREE CITY OF DANZIG, THE INTERWAR MINORITY PROTECTION REGIMES AND A SELF-CONSCIOUS REJECTION OF THE 'LOGIC OF SOVEREIGNTY'. They inspired and were inspired by innovations in labour law: 'INDUSTRIAL WAR' CONTAINED BY ANALOGY WITH 'REAL' WAR, THE DEFECTS OF THE LOGIC OF PROPERTY PARALLELING THOSE OF THE LOGIC OF SOVEREIGNTY. (2) At the same time the social was A KEY SLOGAN OF NATIONALISM ITSELF, in its fascist and authoritarian right-wing forms in many parts of the world, including the new states carved out of the Ottoman and Austro-Hungarian empires and countries such as ARGENTINA (PERÓN) AND BRAZIL (VARGAS). And from this follows a fact that sounds shocking but is exactly what Kennedy claims: IN THE INTERWAR PERIOD, PROGRESSIVE OR REVOLUTIONARY LEFT-WING REFORMERS IN COUNTRIES SUCH AS COLOMBIA AND MEXICO AND THEIR RIGHT-WING ENEMIES USED VIRTUALLY IDENTICAL SOCIAL, CORPORATIST, ANTI-CAPITALIST AND ANTI-LIBERAL RHETORIC. THE MEXICAN FEDERAL LABOUR LAWS OF THE 1930s, THE CELEBRATED ACHIEVEMENT OF THE MEXICAN LEFT'S REVIVAL UNDER CÁRDENAS, CLOSELY RESEMBLED MUSSOLINI'S CARTA DI LAVORO, IF THEY WERE NOT DIRECTLY MODELLED ON IT. (3) IN THE COLONIES nationalism meant NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE and was A CALL TO ARMS OF THE PEOPLE AS A WHOLE AGAINST THE COLONIAL MASTER. The colonial powers recruited natives into the lower reaches of the administrations; elements of pre-colonial elites survived and sought success in the new order through European education. Some found French, British, Dutch and American ACADEMIC MENTOR-ALLIES who helped them TURN PROGRESSIVE METROPOLITAN SOCIAL IDEOLOGY INTO AN ARGUMENT FOR EVERYTHING FROM 'NATIVE WELFARE' TO NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE (FURNIVALL, the Dutch sociologists of adat law, LAMBERT, TUGWELL).

cards.q: How did the social theorists rethink international law because of nationalism, and what came of it?
cards.a: They understood nationalism as A LIFE-GIVING AND LIFE-DESTROYING IRRATIONAL FORCE to be contained and shaped. The result: THE MANDATE SYSTEM, the shift to institutions (THE LEAGUE OF NATIONS), bricolage institutions such as THE FREE CITY OF DANZIG, THE INTERWAR MINORITY PROTECTION REGIMES and A SELF-CONSCIOUS REJECTION OF THE 'LOGIC OF SOVEREIGNTY'.

cards.q: What does the comparison of the Mexican labour laws of the 1930s with the Carta di Lavoro demonstrate?
cards.a: That in the interwar period PROGRESSIVE LEFT-WING REFORMERS AND THEIR RIGHT-WING ENEMIES USED VIRTUALLY IDENTICAL SOCIAL, CORPORATIST, ANTI-CAPITALIST AND ANTI-LIBERAL RHETORIC. The Mexican federal labour laws, the celebrated achievement of the left under CÁRDENAS, closely resembled MUSSOLINI'S CARTA DI LAVORO, if they were not directly modelled on it.

cards.q: How did the social operate in the colonies?
cards.a: Nationalism there meant NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE and a call to arms against the colonial master. Native elites educated in Europe found ACADEMIC MENTOR-ALLIES (Furnivall, the Dutch sociologists of adat law, Lambert, Tugwell) who helped them TURN PROGRESSIVE METROPOLITAN SOCIAL IDEOLOGY INTO AN ARGUMENT FOR EVERYTHING FROM 'NATIVE WELFARE' TO NATIONAL INDEPENDENCE.

36.title: Every nation discovered the same thing — a catalogue of national appropriations
36.text: The pattern Shalakany demonstrated for the Egyptian case repeats itself: CASE AFTER CASE, THE IMPORTING ELITE FOUND IN THE NATIONAL CULTURE SOMETHING THAT MADE THE SOCIAL — AS AGAINST THE FORMALIST INDIVIDUALISM ATTRIBUTED TO CLT — UNIQUELY APPROPRIATE FOR THAT PARTICULAR NATION. THE CATHOLIC SOUTH OF EUROPE (Portugal, Spain, Italy, Hungary): the social is the philosophy of THE CHURCH as stated in RERUM NOVARUM (1897) — 'of new things', that is industrialisation, urbanisation, interdependence; in the 1930s the Vatican made its inglorious accommodation with fascism, immortalised in the social rhetoric of QUADRAGESIMO ANNO. THE PROTESTANT NORTH: the Dutch interpreted the social as particularly appropriate to THE INTERDEPENDENT CULTURE OF DYKE-BUILDING AND LAND RECLAMATION. RUSSIA: the celebrated VILLAGE COMMUNE, THE MIR. THE USA: ROSCOE POUND in a remarkable essay in the Harvard Law Review of JANUARY 1917 LAID THE ILLS OF MODERN AMERICAN SOCIETY AT THE DOOR OF THE 'ROMANISATION' OF AMERICAN LAW in the second half of the 19th century; he presented CLT as an 'ALIEN' mode of legal thought whose formalist individualism had displaced the 'ORGANIC' COMMON LAW MODE BASED ON THE CONCEPT OF 'RELATION' (husband and wife, master and servant, landlord and tenant) — the rediscovery of the medieval common law tradition was to be the basis for bringing American law into accord with the conditions of social interdependence. THERE WERE PRECIOUS FEW CITATIONS OF THE GERMAN AND FRENCH CIVILIAN ORIGINATORS OF THE PROGRAMME. LATIN AMERICA: right-wing authoritarians invoked HISPANIDAD, whose social essence was Catholic yet uniquely American. MEXICO: land reform and the EJIDO system (state-regulated and subsidised cooperative peasant agriculture) was said to be a return to PRE-COLUMBIAN MODES OF SOCIAL ORGANISATION. EGYPT: SANHURI'S eclectic, socially oriented civil code, later adopted or adapted in many other Arab countries, was INDIGENOUS AND EMINENTLY TRADITIONAL AND AT THE SAME TIME ULTRA-MODERN, BECAUSE ISLAMIC LAW WAS AND ALWAYS HAD BEEN SOCIAL. AFRICA: SENGHOR'S NÉGRITUDE, KENYATTA'S 'AFRICAN IDEA OF PROPERTY', NYERERE'S AFRICAN SOCIALISM UJAMAA. CHINA: SUN YAT-SEN and then CHIANG KAI-SHEK developed the nationalist ideology of the KUOMINTANG, the main opponent of Chinese communism, as a complex mixture of CONFUCIAN 'SOCIAL' AND LIBERAL ELEMENTS — AFTER THE SECOND WORLD WAR CHIANG HIRED ROSCOE POUND AS A LEGAL ADVISER in building the legal regime of the Republic of China on Taiwan. And the social as a public law ideology of DISEMPOWERED SUBGROUPS within the British colonial structure: the QUEBECOIS in Canada, the AFRIKANERS in South Africa — there the civilian private law retained THE FORMALISM OF THE MINORITY'S METROPOLE AS A SYMBOL OF RESISTANCE to the common law of the colonial power. PALESTINE: jurists influenced by Savigny and Ehrlich developed a secular 'HEBREW LAW' which was to be first individualist and then social, AND THEN WENT OUT OF FASHION AT PRECISELY THE MOMENT WHEN THE STATE OF ISRAEL BEGAN TO DEVELOP A HIGHLY SOCIAL PUBLIC LAW REGIME.

cards.q: How did Roscoe Pound appropriate the social for America in 1917?
cards.a: In an essay in the Harvard Law Review he laid the ills of modern American society AT THE DOOR OF THE 'ROMANISATION' OF AMERICAN LAW in the second half of the 19th century: he presented CLT as an 'ALIEN' MODE whose formalist individualism had displaced the 'ORGANIC' COMMON LAW MODE BASED ON THE CONCEPT OF 'RELATION'. THERE WERE PRECIOUS FEW CITATIONS OF THE GERMAN AND FRENCH ORIGINATORS.

cards.q: Name at least five national appropriations of the social.
cards.a: THE CATHOLIC SOUTH: the philosophy of the Church in RERUM NOVARUM (1897). THE NETHERLANDS: the culture of DYKE-BUILDING AND LAND RECLAMATION. RUSSIA: the village commune, the MIR. MEXICO: the EJIDO system as a return to PRE-COLUMBIAN modes. EGYPT: Sanhuri's code, because ISLAMIC LAW ALWAYS HAD BEEN SOCIAL. AFRICA: Senghor's NÉGRITUDE, Kenyatta's 'African idea of property', Nyerere's UJAMAA. CHINA: the Confucian 'social' in Kuomintang ideology.

cards.q: Why did Afrikaner and Quebecois private law retain its formalism?
cards.a: Because THE CIVILIAN PRIVATE LAW OF THE MINORITY'S METROPOLE FUNCTIONED AS A SYMBOL OF RESISTANCE to THE COMMON LAW OF THE COLONIAL POWER. The social there served instead as the public law ideology of a disempowered subgroup within the British colonial structure.

37.title: Why every nation discovered the same thing — the invented-communities hypothesis
37.text: Savigny's formalist derivation of the whole of private law from right and will gave way to Savigny's insistence that national legal orders REPRESENT AND OUGHT TO REPRESENT THE PARTICULAR NORMATIVE ORDER OF THE PEOPLE IN QUESTION. BUT THE QUESTION REMAINS WHY, AT THE MOMENT OF DISCOVERING NATIONAL PARTICULARITY, EVERY NATION DISCOVERED THE SAME THING. Kennedy's easy but initially plausible explanation: THE SOCIAL WAS AN INSTRUMENT OF ELITES FACING PRECISELY THE ABSENCE OF THE SOCIAL — elites charged with administering territories TORN BY CLASS CONFLICT or containing WILDLY HETEROGENEOUS TRIBAL, CULTURAL, RACIAL AND RELIGIOUS GROUPS, first assembled as colonies according to the interests of empires and great powers and then, at national independence, re-parcelled according to the interests of great powers and local elites. THE IDEOLOGY OF THE SOCIAL WAS (perhaps) NOT A REFLECTION OF NATIONAL PARTICULARITY BUT AN INSTRUMENT IN THE 'INVENTION' OF AS YET NON-EXISTENT NATIONAL COMMUNITIES (HOBSBAWM, ANDERSON). This hypothesis is, on Kennedy's view, supported by the story of gender in the social.

cards.q: Why, on Kennedy's account, did every nation 'discover' the same thing in the social?
cards.a: Because THE SOCIAL WAS AN INSTRUMENT OF ELITES FACING PRECISELY THE ABSENCE OF THE SOCIAL — territories torn by class conflict or wildly heterogeneous in tribe, culture, race and religion. THE IDEOLOGY OF THE SOCIAL WAS NOT A REFLECTION OF NATIONAL PARTICULARITY BUT AN INSTRUMENT IN THE 'INVENTION' OF AS YET NON-EXISTENT NATIONAL COMMUNITIES (Hobsbawm, Anderson).

38.title: Sex and the family: the dramatic ambiguity of the social
38.text: The idea of 'the social' was DRAMATICALLY AMBIGUOUS when applied to family and sexual relations. The social demanded that employers treat workers, and merchants treat consumers, according to A SOCIAL ETHIC, and the rhetoric was SOLIDARITY AND COMMUNITY. The construction of the relations of family members as inherently ALTRUISTIC AND PROTECTIVE was an obvious reference and support for the demands of workers and consumers. In one sense it was a matter of REVERSING THE 19TH-CENTURY DISSOLUTION OF THE HOUSEHOLD AND REIMPOSING ON THE CAPITALIST THE DUTIES OF THE PATRIARCH, THIS TIME WITH STATE ENFORCEMENT OF SOLIDARITY INSTEAD OF TOLERANCE OF DISCRETION. The enemies of the social tirelessly pointed out that this was a 'REGRESSION' FROM CONTRACT TO STATUS and that it was 'degrading' to treat beneficiaries as though, like members of a Roman or feudal household, they lacked legal capacity. AT THE SAME TIME, HOWEVER, THE SOCIAL MEANT MODERNITY. The progressive social approach to sex and the family in the North Atlantic was markedly SECULAR, influenced by THE FIRST WAVE OF WESTERN FEMINISM, and itself influenced the most secular and most Western segments of the peripheral elites. Its programme: TO RELAX MANY OF THE PROHIBITIONS OF THE 19TH-CENTURY GENDER REGIME AND AT THE SAME TIME TO INCREASE THE INTRUSIVE ENFORCEMENT OF THE DUTIES OF THE PATRIARCH THAT CLT HAD REGARDED AS MERELY MORAL, NOT LEGAL. Social ideology treated the family as AN INSTITUTION WITH FUNCTIONS AND PURPOSES ESSENTIAL TO THE SOCIAL WHOLE — the family was neither a matter of purely private concern nor an area quarantined as moral rather than legal.

cards.q: In what way was the social ambiguous when applied to the family?
cards.a: On one side it wanted to REVERSE THE 19TH-CENTURY DISSOLUTION OF THE HOUSEHOLD AND REIMPOSE ON THE CAPITALIST THE DUTIES OF THE PATRIARCH (with state enforcement of solidarity instead of tolerance of discretion) — which its enemies called a 'REGRESSION FROM CONTRACT TO STATUS'. On the other side IT MEANT MODERNITY: it was secular and influenced by the first wave of feminism.

cards.q: What was the progressive social programme for the family, in one sentence?
cards.a: TO RELAX MANY OF THE PROHIBITIONS OF THE 19TH-CENTURY GENDER REGIME AND AT THE SAME TIME TO INCREASE THE INTRUSIVE ENFORCEMENT OF THE DUTIES OF THE PATRIARCH THAT CLT HAD REGARDED AS MERELY MORAL, NOT LEGAL. The family became AN INSTITUTION with functions essential to the social whole — not a matter of purely private concern.
